title: Dispatch: establish a held row's variant once via adopt_item (attempt 1, Haiku)
description:
Implementation dispatch for eshyra-0xaq (Haiku 5.5). Worktree .worktrees/eshyra-0xaq.1, branch eshyra-0xaq.1 (cut from eshyra-0xaq = origin/main 2f747ddf). Deps installed (npm ci).

GOAL: a narrow, ONE-TIME path to establish the variant of an already pack-bound held inventory row whose variant_id is NULL, for a record that (now) declares variants (Horn of Valhalla rows held before its horn-type variants existed; equally any later variant-bearing item such as Bag of Tricks or Elemental Gem). Never a reselection: a row that already has a variant can never be changed by this path.

DESIGN (decided by the supervisor; do not redesign):
1. Location: extend adopt_item. File packages/core/src/state/itemAdoption.ts, function adoptMagicItem, the branch `if (row.pack_ref !== null) {` (around line 478). Today it throws 'already bound to a different canonical item' when `row.variant_id !== (variantId ?? null)`. Add, BEFORE that throw, the establish-once case:
   condition: row.pack_ref === packRef && row.variant_id === null && variantId !== undefined (resolveMagicItemVariant already guarantees variantId is declared by the record, and it is required when the record declares variants).
   Refuse (ItemAdoptionError, nothing changed) when any of these exist for this instance id, because they were created under the variant-less identity: an unredeemed OR redeemed row in item_grant_bind_credit (item_instance_id), an item_consumption_receipt row for it, any active_effects row whose source item instance is this id (find the column used by activeEffects.ts for source itemInstanceId), or an existing item adoption review (existingReview !== undefined). Look up exact table/column names in packages/core/data/schema.snapshot.sql; do not guess.
   Then: UPDATE inventory SET variant_id = ? WHERE id = ? AND variant_id IS NULL (check changes === 1). If an item_state row exists for the instance (see how itemState.ts reads/writes it, readItemState / state_json and its `variantId` field), rewrite its variantId to the new variant and re-validate it with the existing validator for the record+variant (validateItemStateForRecord or the function itemState.ts already uses on load); if the stored state is not valid for the chosen variant, throw and roll back (the whole function already runs in withTransaction).
   If the record is stateful for the chosen variant (isStatefulMagicItem(record, variantId)) and row.quantity !== 1, refuse.
   Return adopted: true, alreadyBound: true, establishedVariant: true (add `readonly establishedVariant?: boolean` to AdoptMagicItemResult), variantId.
   Durable record: the establish must leave a durable, append-only trace with provenance/sessionId/at. Check whether itemAdoption.ts / itemAdoptionReview.ts already has an append-only resolution/event table usable without a review (recordItemAdoptionResolution requires previousReview). If none fits, add a minimal migration (next number after the highest in packages/core/src/state/migrations or wherever 0050_item_grant_bind_credit_rolled_counts.sql lives) creating `item_variant_establishment(inventory_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, campaign_id, pack_ref, variant_id, established_at, provenance, session_id)`; PRIMARY KEY on inventory_id makes it once-only at the DB level. Update packages/core/data/schema.snapshot.sql the way the 0050 migration did (follow how the repo regenerates/asserts the snapshot; persistence.test.ts / migration tests may pin the latest migration number - update those pins).
2. Tool: packages/core/src/orchestrator/toolAdoptItem.ts description: add one sentence: a held row already bound to the packRef but with no variant (held before the item's variants existed) can have its variant established ONCE by adopt_item with that packRef and variantId; it can never be changed afterwards. Surface establishedVariant in the tool's ok result alongside the existing fields.
3. Also update the give_item description sentence about the Horn (packages/core/src/orchestrator/toolGiveItem.ts line ~37) ONLY by appending: "A horn already held with no type gets it once through adopt_item." Nothing else in toolGiveItem.ts.

EVIDENCE (packages/core/test/itemAdoption.test.ts, or a new focused test file next to it; real SRD pack, use how existing adoption/Horn tests load the pack, e.g. test/importers/dnd5e-srd-5.1/hornOfValhallaVariants.test.ts and itemGrantRolledCount.test.ts helpers):
 a. A Horn of Valhalla row with pack_ref set and variant_id NULL (insert it directly as a pre-variant save would hold it) -> adopt_item with variantId 'brass' establishes it; the row's variant is 'brass'; then use_item on the horn's operation succeeds and issues a credit whose rolledCounts notation is 3d4+3 (proves the established identity is live).
 b. A second adopt_item with variantId 'iron' on the same row is refused and the row stays 'brass' (no reselection). Also: a row given with variant 'silver' via give_item is refused when adopt_item names 'bronze'.
 c. Refused when the instance has an item_grant_bind_credit row (insert one or produce one) - row stays NULL.
 d. Refused with an undeclared variantId.
 Negative-proof each new assertion once (temporarily break the code, see it fail, restore) and say so in your report.

DO NOT: touch the rules pack, importer, or any file not listed; add a generic 'change variant' capability; weaken any existing test.

PROCESS: implement; from the worktree root run `npm run verify:worktree` (it rewrites files) and it must pass BEFORE committing; commit on branch eshyra-0xaq.1 with a message starting 'eshyra-0xaq.1' and ending with the line `Co-Authored-By: Claude Haiku 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>`; record a completion report (files changed, decisions, test names, negative proofs, verify result) via `bd update eshyra-0xaq.1 --append-notes "..."`; file any discovered follow-up with bd create; then `bd close eshyra-0xaq.1`.
notes:
SUPERVISOR ADDENDUM: migration number. A parallel dispatch (eshyra-olc5.16.1) takes migration 0051. If you need the item_variant_establishment migration, number it 0052 and put it after 0051 in any ordered list; if the runner requires contiguous numbering and 0051 is absent on your branch, tell me in your report rather than renumbering — I will integrate after olc5.16.
BLOCKED (attempt 1, Haiku): stopped before any edit; worktree clean, no commit, bead left open.

1. Migration blocker. Durable trace needs a new table, and no existing table fits. inventory_adoption_resolution has CHECK constraints on action (4 values) and previous_review_kind, and recordItemAdoptionResolution requires previousReview. inventory_custody_event, active_effect_event and character_wallet_event do not fit.
2. Adding 0052 on this branch breaks every database open. packages/core/src/persistence/migrationRunner.ts (~line 219) throws 'non-contiguous migration versions' because 0051 is absent on eshyra-0xaq.1 (origin/main ends at 0050). Per the addendum I did not renumber. Verify cannot pass with 0052 alone.
3. Options for supervisor: (a) integrate after olc5.16.1 lands 0051, then dispatch again with 0052; or (b) approve a different durable-record shape. The bound-row branch is itemAdoption.ts line 478 (if (row.pack_ref !== null)), so the code change itself is unblocked; only the trace is.
Re-dispatch once 0051 is on the base.
SUPERVISOR 2026-10-31: accepted option 1. Blocked on eshyra-olc5.16.1 landing migration 0051; will re-dispatch (attempt 2) off a parent rebased on that, with the migration as 0052.
